facts.fact: Rosalind 的狼一闻到身边这个莽汉的气味就想去玩，她怪不了它。
facts.anchor: my inner beast took one deep whiff of the brute standing next to us and immediately decided she wanted to play

facts.fact: 她从还在母亲子宫里起就被监视、追踪、看守。
facts.anchor: I’d been watched, tracked, and guarded since I was floating in my mother’s womb.

facts.fact: 逃亡是终极目标，但自由先于逃亡——第一步就是嫁给一个 Blackwood。
facts.anchor: Escape was the ultimate goal. But to escape, I needed freedom first. And it started right here, with saying I do to a Blackwood.

facts.fact: 她把 Gunnar 判读成蠢而护主的莽汉，认定好操纵。
facts.anchor: A dumb, protective brute will be laughably easy to manipulate.

facts.fact: 七岁那年 Fenrir 与她母亲签约，把她的终身像牲口一样绑给 Blackwood 血脉。
facts.anchor: signing away my life and binding me to his bloodline like a piece of livestock

facts.fact: 核心反转：她是母亲练出来的大师级间谍，不是娇小姐。
facts.anchor: never thinking that my battle-tested mother hadn't raised a little princess, but a master spy

facts.fact: 誓词里的 obey 在她舌头像毒药，她继续扮演温顺的新娘。
facts.anchor: The word obey tasted like pure, acrid poison on my tongue.

facts.fact: 章末：Gunnar 不知道自己迎进门的是他家族覆灭的设计师。
facts.anchor: He had no idea he had just brought the architect of his pack's destruction into his family's den.
